flags.message: context.json's distribution_count of 2 counts the May 19 2026 distribution of the linked seal motion (25M82) alongside the petition's own single June 17 2026 distribution. The petition has never been relisted; a count read as 'relisted once' plausibly inflated the frozen 'elevated' band. The relist-increment claim was stated from the frozen count of 2 as required, but the band anchor may overstate this docket's trajectory.

CourtListener opinion 10750028 (the CA4 decision below, 24-1959, filed 2025-12-08) has mismatched text: read_document returns a D. Or. opinion (Northwest Investment Holdings v. PacWest Funding, 3:24-cv-01144-HZ). The decision below could not be read and its 'Published' status is unverified; the prediction relied on the petition's account of it.
